channel.title: Treasure Coast Today
channel.description: Local news for Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties, Florida.

item.title: North Palm Beach celebrates Independence Day with fireworks and America 250 events at country club
item.description: North Palm Beach residents and visitors will celebrate Independence Day with family-friendly activities, live entertainment and fireworks at North Palm Beach Country Club and The Clubhouse on July 4.

item.title: Juno Beach weighs cost of replacing fence at JB-7 beach access after resident complaints
item.description: A missing fence at the JB-7 public beach access point has prompted complaints from Colony Condos residents who say beachgoers are trespassing on private property. The Juno Beach Town Council will take up the fence question during budget discussions July 15.

item.title: Martin County School Board challenges judge's order to reinstate teacher suspended over Charlie Kirk comments
item.description: The Martin County School Board filed a court challenge Thursday against an administrative law judge's recommendation to reinstate a teacher suspended last year .

item.title: Riviera Beach named only Florida city to receive 2026 All-America City Award
item.description: Riviera Beach was named one of just 10 communities in the U.S. to receive the 2026 All-America City Award from the National Civic League. The city highlighted programs including the Riviera Beach Youth Council and the Neighborhood Reclaim Home Rehabilitation Program.

item.title: Palm Beach County schools earn third consecutive 'A' rating with record 93.5% graduation rate
item.description: The School District of Palm Beach County received an 'A' rating from the state for the third consecutive year. The district achieved a record-setting 93.5% graduation rate, with 143 schools rated A or B.

item.title: Boca Raton Community High School band to represent Florida at National Independence Day Parade
item.description: The Boca Raton Community High School band will march in Washington, D.C.'s National Independence Day Parade on July 4. The students will march a full mile along the National Mall, representing the entire state of Florida.

item.title: Breast cancer patient and surgeon speak out after insurance denies reconstruction surgery hours before procedure
item.description: Beth Clark, 48, and her plastic surgeon are speaking out after Anthem Blue Cross and Blue Shield denied coverage for a reconstruction procedure less than 24 hours before it was scheduled. The denial involved surgical mesh called GalaFlex, which the insurer considers investigational.

item.title: Fourth of July cookout costs rise 4% this year, summer meal for 10 now costs $73.82
item.description: A holiday meal for 10 now costs $73.82, up 4% from a year ago, according to the American Farm Bureau Federation's Summer Cookout Cost Survey. Ground beef is up 5.5%, buns are up 7.7%, and strawberries are up 12.4%.

item.title: Hobe Sound woman killed in house fire had birthday on Fourth of July
item.description: Misty Dawn White died Monday in a house fire that investigators believe was caused by an electrical issue. Friends are now raising funds for her fiance, who lost his only child in an earlier tragedy.

item.title: Martin County School Board fights judge's order to reinstate teacher suspended over Charlie Kirk Facebook comments
item.description: The Martin County School Board filed court papers Thursday challenging a judge's recommendation to reinstate a teacher suspended last year for Facebook comments.

item.title: Juno Beach condo residents push town to replace fence at JB-7 beach access point
item.description: Colony Condo residents say beachgoers are cutting through private property at the JB-7 public walkway since the town removed an old fence in 2023. A replacement could cost thousands.

item.title: Stuart downtown dock closes Sunday for $3 million renovation
item.description: The public dock will close July 6 for a year-long renovation that will nearly double its capacity from 18 to 44 boat slips.

item.title: Port St. Lucie moves forward with Florida Turnpike interchange at Midway Road
item.description: The Port St. Lucie City Council approved giving 7 acres of land to the Florida Department of Transportation to build a partial interchange on the Turnpike as part of the Midway Road Widening Project.

item.title: West Palm Beach considers elevated self-driving transit system connecting airport to downtown
item.description: California-based Glydways will present a proposal to Palm Beach County commissioners Tuesday for an elevated network of autonomous vehicles that could cut the trip between downtown and the airport to less than 10 minutes.

item.title: St. Lucie County deputies make 15 DUI arrests in holiday enforcement
item.description: Deputies targeted impaired driving in St. Lucie County ahead of the Fourth of July weekend.

item.title: Riviera Beach named only Florida city to win 2026 All-America City Award
item.description: Riviera Beach was selected as one of just 10 communities in the U.S. to receive the 2026 All-America City Award from the National Civic League, making it the only Florida city to earn the honor this year.

item.description: Misty Dawn White, 46, was found dead Monday after a fire broke out inside her Hobe Sound home. Preliminary findings from the sheriff's office point to an electrical issue as a possible cause.

item.description: The Boca Raton Community High School band has earned a coveted spot in Washington, D.C.'s National Independence Day Parade and will represent the entire state of Florida on July 4.

item.description: Martin County Maritime Response Unit is deploying two boats with medics on standby as hundreds of boaters hit the waterways for Independence Day weekend.

item.description: Friends launched a fundraiser to help Mark rebuild after a fire killed his fiancée Misty Dawn White and destroyed their belongings in Hobe Sound.

item.description: Loggerhead Marinelife Center in Juno Beach is offering educational and interactive programs during peak sea turtle nesting season through September. item.description: Florida education officials this week moved forward with significant new barriers for undocumented students seeking higher education in the state. item.title: Byron Donalds secures $90 million in fundraising and major endorsements as Florida GOP primary approaches
item.description: The Republican gubernatorial candidate launched a $20 million statewide advertising buy and gained support from two DeSantis-appointed statewide officials as the August primary draws closer.

item.title: DeSantis allies accuse Jay Collins' wife of running anonymous social media accounts critical of governor
item.description: Multiple social media accounts were deactivated after prominent DeSantis communications veterans presented evidence tying them to Lt. Gov. Jay Collins' wife Layla Collins.

item.title: St. Petersburg selects $8.1 billion proposal to redevelop Tropicana Field site with permanent home for Woodson Museum
item.description: The Burg Bid plan calls for purchasing 58 acres of city-owned land for $275 million and transforming the area into a mixed-use district centered around a 13-acre civic park.

item.title: Secretary of State Cord Byrd asks court to keep Paula Stark off ballot after incomplete qualifying paperwork
item.description: Five state employees submitted sworn declarations saying Stark's treasurer never submitted the required Form 6 disclosure and was not accidentally handed it back during last-minute filing.

item.title: Jay Collins files lawsuit challenging James Fishback's eligibility for Florida governor's race
item.description: The lawsuit argues Fishback does not meet Florida's constitutional requirement that a governor live in the state for at least seven years before being elected.

item.title: Woodson African American Museum of Florida to reopen with Smithsonian-linked exhibition as part of 20th anniversary
item.description: The museum's newly renovated facility reopens July 11 with an America 250 exhibition. The Woodson was selected as one of only three Florida organizations to present the Many Voices One Nation exhibition.
